title: Pack writes the source directory's entries and .compiled/, in byte order, each byte for byte and stored when deflating does not shorten it, leaving out the quiet top-level names silently and every other one with a warning, into <name>-<version>.metais in an existing directory or into the file named, and the package opens
notes: The expected packages were written by metais pack, and are compared by entries: names, order, content and the fixed header fields. Methods are compared only where they are the encoder's to choose no other way: references/empty.txt is empty and assets/noise.bin is 96 random bytes, so both are stored. The source's references/notes.md carries a byte order mark and CRLF line endings, which are packed as they are; assets/.well-known/security.txt is a dotfile inside a layout tree, which is packed; .hidden and old.metais are quiet top-level names, left out with no finding; notes.txt, drafts/ and archive.metais/, a directory whose name ends in .metais and so is not the quiet regular file, are left out, each reported as package.layout.not_packed, a warning that does not stop pack. Environments A and B differ in their time zone, locale and clock, and must give the same bytes.
